articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin hits $87,000, while traders pile into leveraged bets
articles.snippet: Crypto majors climbed alongside equity futures on Monday, with Monero's XMR up 13%, as Brent fell for a fourth straight session and traders positioned for Trump-Xi summit later this week.

articles.title: Trump says US will form ‘AI Force’ and appoint AI czar: Reports
articles.snippet: Trump posted on Truth Social that his new project would manage the fast-growing sector without adding regulations that could slow innovation.
